column1: ## Zhang 2011 Figure 2A — per-residue clone counts and amino-acid letters at each crizotinib concentration.
## Audit record. Source: Fig 2A of Zhang et al. 2011 (Chem Biol Drug Des 10.1111/j.1747-0285.2011.01239.x).
## Read from the figure bars at ~±2 percentage points precision. The "letters" column records the amino-acid
## substitutions visible as stacked labels within each bar; order follows the figure's visual stacking.
## The within-residue breakdown by amino acid is NOT resolvable at variant-count precision from Fig 2A alone;
## only the aggregated per-residue frequency is read directly from the bar height. The authors' Table 2 names
## the single most frequent variant at 10 of the 16 residues; those are recorded under "table2_variant".
## WT = outgrowth wells with no kinase-domain mutation (not a mutation per se).
## N_WELLS_WITH_OUTGROWTH column = approximate number of outgrowth wells at each concentration
## reported in the paper as "~700" (500 nM)
## wells with outgrowth. The number of MUTATION-POSITIVE clones among them is approximately
## N_wells * (1 - WT_frac).
## Columns:
##   crizotinib_nM           — selection concentration (nM)
##   n_outgrowth_wells       — approx total outgrowth wells at that concentration (paper-reported)
##   residue                 — ALK residue number
##   wt_aa                   — one-letter WT amino acid
##   bar_pct_approx          — approximate height of residue bar as % of recovered clones (±2pp)
##   letters_visible         — amino-acid letters stacked within the bar (uppercase
##   table2_variant          — single variant called out in Zhang 2011 Table 2 (if any)
##   notes
